control_profile: Volatility-target only: unchanged +0.25 price-confirmed carry targets with no drawdown brake, position stop, time stop or turnover throttle.
falsifier: Volatility scaling alone fails to lower turnover and preserve role/fold economics, showing that target membership—not the full control stack—drives churn.
formation_horizon: robust seven-day and twenty-eight-day settled funding with a twenty-eight-day BTC state, twenty-one-bar residual scale and nine-bar price confirmation at z 0.25
hypothesis: Retaining only causal no-leverage volatility scaling isolates whether stops, cooldowns, drawdown brakes and turnover throttling create churn or suppress the confirmed carry edge.
rebalance_horizon: one daily cohort averaged across seven overlapping daily vintages
